Instrument (EN): Couples' Sleep Conflict Scale — original 5-item US romantic-relationship scale
Scales / measured domains (EN): Overall couple/partner conflict related to sleep habits, schedule, preferences and sleep environment (one factor); not an insomnia or clinical sleep diagnosis.
Research provenance: Novak JR, Miller K, Gunn HE, Troxel WM. Sleep Health 10(3):308-315, online 2024-04-10, DOI 10.1016/j.sleh.2024.01.009. Primary development and validation: one sample N158 individuals and separate sample N143 mixed-gender romantic couples; one-factor 5-item solution; partial invariance between concordant and discordant chronotypes.
DB locales: 2026-10-27 production app.assessment_versions: 149 published distinct definition keys; 234 published locales EN154 RU80 ES0. No CSCS definition key in published DB.

Target population: US romantic relationship adults N158 individuals and N143 mixed-gender couples; findings cannot automatically generalize to all partnership types or populations.

Instrument (EN): Couples' Sleep Conflict Scale — Turkish 5-item cultural/psychometric adaptation
Scales / measured domains (EN): Overall partner sleep-related conflict, one factor/5 items across female, male and pooled subsamples; alpha women .838, men .827, pooled .835; convergent and test-retest psychometrics.
Research provenance: Ünal E, Duman M. Chronobiology International 43(4):567-575, online 2026-01-20 (NOT an October study), DOI 10.1080/07420528.2026.2617891. Three-stage Turkish language/content/pilot adaptation, EFA/CFA in women, men and total group; sufficient reliability in adult married respondent group; article abstract does not report sample n.
DB locales: 2026-10-27 production 149 distinct published assessment keys/234 respondent language versions; no CSCS key. Original US research row cscs-novak2024-enus5-original.
EN form: Original US instrument exists; this study does NOT independently validate an English edition.
Other translations: TR-TR independently language-adapted and psychometrically assessed in this 2026 study (5 items, one factor). TOAD Turkey scale catalogue confirms adaptation and says author permission REQUIRED even for scientific research; commercial not allowed by that notice.
Target population: Married adults over 18 in Turkish research setting; not established for unmarried couples, minors, or sleep disorder clinic screening.
Commercial digital use / permission revi: TOAD author-use notice explicitly requires email to corresponding author with purpose even for scientific use; no commercial SaaS/digital redistribution permission. Both original developer and adapting author rights must be cleared, official Turkish items and score mapping before deployment.
Verification notes / safety gate: INDEPENDENTLY VALIDATED TR respondent adaptation (study-specific), not permission to digitize/use commercially. No automated couples therapy diagnosis, no copied question text/scoring or site/Supabase changes. Turkish sample number in freely accessible primary abstract unspecified, so not asserted.

Scales / measured domains (EN): Self-communication presence (SCP); Self-emotional experience (SEE); Partner contribution (PC); Partner responsiveness (PR); Communication characteristics (CC). Five-factor couple communication satisfaction; not Career Counseling Self-Efficacy CCSS.
